messages:
sam (design): Quick note from mobile usability session: table on console is overflowing at narrow widths and the collapsed left nav overlays action buttons so users can't tap 'Open'. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/mobile-ux :grimacing:

harper (frontend): repro on 360x800. .actions-cell has min-width:120px which forces a horizontal scrollbar.

toni (product): this is blocking support flows - people triage on phones. We need a small-scope fix first.

sam (design): proposal A: quick fix = collapse secondary actions into kebab at <=420px and reduce min-width. Proposal B: better UX = switch to card list or stacked rows under 420px for touch friendliness.

harper (frontend): technical note: we use react-window virtualization. Stacked rows can be CSS-only if we keep the same row element; cards require changing renderer and perf testing. Quick fix doable today.

lee (mobile): if we do overlay/sidebar changes, prefer overlay (position:fixed) not push, and make it a bottom sheet on small screens. Use safe-area-inset for notch. Swipe-to-close ok but ensure keyboard dismiss works.

aria-a11y-bot: a11y checklist: kebab must have aria-label="More actions for run", overlay/bottom-sheet needs role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" + focus trap. Restore focus to trigger on close and announce state change.

toni (product): copy tweak: kebab menu item should be "Open details" and drawer header should be short run id first line, full model name truncated on second line with tooltip/long-press to reveal.

harper (frontend): plan: land quick fix (kebab + remove min-width) behind ff_mobile_table_layout by EOD, then prototype stacked rows/card list for next sprint behind ff_mobile_card_list. Will include QA steps for landscape and rotation.

sam (design): I'll upload 320/375/412 mocks and add acceptance criteria: no horizontal scroll at those widths, kebab touch target >=44px, overlay traps focus. :thumbsup:
